body:
Bench `numeric_eval_group`, governed against ungoverned:

| Threads | Fuel | Scratch | Metered |
|---|---|---|---|
| 4 | 0.98× | 1.10× | 1.42× |
| 32 | 0.85× | 1.13× | 1.72× |

Main showed the same ratio before the exact numeric tower landed, so this is not a regression. But metered mode is well over the 1.2× overhead target.

Required: profile the metered path (per-row charging, ledger updates, scratch accounting) and bring metered overhead to at most 1.2× at 4 and 32 threads. Prove it with purrdf_testkit bench lanes. Determinism and the governor profile vectors must not change, unless the profile version is bumped with regenerated vectors.
title: SPARQL governor: metered governed evaluation costs 1.4–1.7× ungoverned (target 1.2×)
